params.name: identifier
params.description: The identifier of the media provider containing the media to rate.  Typically `com.plexapp.plugins.library`

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the item to rate.  This is the `ratingKey` found in metadata items

params.name: rating
params.description: The rating to give the item.

params.name: ratedAt
params.description: The time when the rating occurred.  If not present, interpreted as now.

items.docs:
Set the rating on an item.
This API does respond to the GET verb but applications should use PUT
